In detail

Secondigliano is one of the historical strongholds of organised crime in Naples (the base of the Di Lauro clan and, after its 2005 split, the "Scissionisti di Secondigliano"), and the Court of Appeal names "Miano-San Pietro a Patierno" among the highest-stese areas; Secondigliano is also named among the five zones most affected by the 92 stese recorded across the city in 2024. A genuine, funded 2025 regeneration programme for Scampia and Secondigliano together, backed by the national government and the Comune, is under way, which is a real and positive development — but it is a multi-year plan still in its early stages, not a change already reflected in the crime pattern. Sources checked: Fanpage.it, 26/28 Jun 2023, citing the Naples Court of Appeal report; Napolitan.it, 13 Apr 2025 (92 stese in 2024, zones named); Ottopagine.it / Periferiamonews.org, May 2025 (Scampia-Secondigliano regeneration plan).
